units.source_text: 色彩斑驳的佛像、天人、马和莲花座，他几乎为这些倾倒。

en.t: He was almost enchanted by the mottled colors of the Buddhist statues, celestial beings, horses, and lotus pedestals.

units.source_text: 他仰望着它们，忘了一切。

en.t: He looked up at them and forgot everything.

units.source_text: 甚至忘记了他自己幸运的摆脱了狂人的女儿……

en.t: He even forgot that he himself had fortunately escaped from the madman's daughter...
